code='''def transform(grid):
    """Complete the rectangular perimeter around all non-background marks."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    marks = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    if not marks:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in marks); r1 = max(r for r, c in marks)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in marks); c1 = max(c for r, c in marks)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
        if out[r0][c] == bg: out[r0][c] = 2
        if out[r1][c] == bg: out[r1][c] = 2
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        if out[r][c0] == bg: out[r][c0] = 2
        if out[r][c1] == bg: out[r][c1] = 2
    return out
'''
